title: External query string parameters in urls are sent to the API
body:
When we have a url like `www.website.com/page.html?s=param&query=a` it will send it will automatically append "test" to the "synonyms" value of the searchParameters, resulting in the request to Algolia failing.

https://codepen.io/rayrutjes/full/dXOWwX/?s=test
